title: susi config diff: show only user overrides (goal: empty)
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. List keys whose effective value differs from the derived default; an empty list is the zero-config state. Tests zc_config_overrides_*.
